adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` callback normalizes `host` by stripping protocol and then `self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`, which removes any path segment. As a result, values like `example.com/blog-a` and `example.com/blog-b` will both be persisted as `example.com`, making path-specific host→category mappings impossible and potentially creating duplicate/ambiguous rows (there is no uniqueness validation/DB constraint in the migration). Additionally, the validation regex allows an optional path `(\/.*)?`, but that portion is effectively unreachable because the path is always removed before validation.
